text:
marta: FYI saw a weird cluster from this morning's autopay: 12 declines (~$38k) but reasons split between 'issuer_block' (6), 'expired' (3) and 3 ACH micro-deposit mismatches. Looks like a bank-level block for several mid-market accounts. Thoughts on escalation + temporary service hold policy?

billing-bot: autopay-batch 2026-03-11T06:08Z summary: total_attempts=389, declines=12, decline_total=38150, top_accounts=[OrchidThera:$15000, Helix:$9000], decline_codes=[issuer_block, expired_card, ach_mismatch].

aj: for issuer_block we usually retry after 24h and notify the customer to contact their bank. I'll kick off t+24h retry and set 'escalate_to_finops' for >$5k. For ACH mismatches, send micro-deposit resend and hold autopay until verification.

laura: can we surface a one-click 'request wire' link in those dunning emails? Sales asked for a faster path; some customers prefer wire for large invoices.

nora: agree on manual wire path for >$10k. But don't auto-disable services for accounts mid-contract w/o CS signoff. Mark OrchidThera & Helix as manual-review.

trevor: I'll reach out to OrchidThera. If bank block persists, they may need to call their payments team. Ask them to try a different card or wire.

sam: support queue has 2 tickets about 'payment blocked by issuer' — forwarding standard script. Copy below: 
"Hi {contact}, our payment attempt was declined by your bank. Common fixes: try another card, contact the card issuer to lift the block, or request a one-time wire. Need help selecting an option? Reply and we'll assist.

"
aj: running retry job (t+24h) and flagging accounts for manual outreach: 
POST /internal/billing/retry {batch_id:2026-03-11-early, strategy:24h_delay, notify_on_fail:true} 

marta: action items: 1) aj schedule 24h retries (done), 2) laura + billing to add wire link to dunning email (laura owning), 3) trevor contact OrchidThera/Helix then update thread, 4) nora hold any auto-cancels for flagged accounts, 5) sam update support scripts with bank-block troubleshooting.

billing-bot: dunning schedule: immediate_notify + 24h retry + 72h escalate-to-sales-for-top-accounts.

trevor: on it, pinging OrchidThera PM now. Will update when I have outcome.

marta: thanks all — keep this thread updated. If we get 2nd-wave issuer_block across more accounts we may open an incident to check gateway/provider changes. :eyes:
